notes:
v4.6.134 — Positions now match your broker, and stay matched

🛠 Root-cause fix: bots now wait for the REAL broker fill before recording a trade, instead of assuming the full order filled instantly. That was the source of 'phantom' positions — holdings the app showed that your IBKR account didn't actually hold (e.g. an order that only partially filled was booked in full).

🔁 New automatic hourly two-way reconcile keeps the live account and the bots' books in sync in BOTH directions: it sells off any untracked positions the broker holds, AND corrects any phantom over-counts in the bots' ledgers — so the app and your broker can't silently drift apart.

Update via the in-app banner.
